description: Only for business owners signed in to Awning. Change name, description, street address and its map point, public contacts, cancellation rules or automatic confirmation. Pass lat and lng with a new address when you know them; without them the old map point is dropped. A new name for a live business is reviewed by Awning first: customers keep seeing the current name until the team approves it, and the response says so under rename — tell the owner. Sending the current name again withdraws a new name that is waiting; a change of letter case only goes through at once. What is sent replaces what is there. Confirm with the owner first. Use it for changes to a business that exists; during setup use owner_setup, and for services and prices owner_add_offering and owner_update_offering.

address.description: Street address, e.g. 'Bedford Avenue 120'. The city and country stay as they are.

auto_confirm.description: True: bookings are confirmed at once. False: the owner confirms each request.

business_id.description: Which business, when the owner runs several: business_id from owner_status. Leave out when there is only one.

contacts.description: Public contacts customers see: phone, whatsapp, telegram, instagram, website, email (public_email means the same as email). An empty string clears one; the ones not sent stay as they are.

description.description: What the business is, a few sentences

free_cancel_hours.description: Free cancellation until this many hours before the start

lat.description: Latitude of the new address, when known

late_fee_pct.description: Share of the price kept for a later cancellation, in percent

lng.description: Longitude of the new address, when known

name.description: The business's name. A live business keeps its current name until Awning approves a new one.

name: owner_update_business
title: Update business details
